draft_body:
Dear SURP Research and Publication team,

Your February 2026 news about co-producing community empowerment through Alternative Temporary Shelters suggests a relevant participatory research connection (https://surp.upd.edu.ph/).

I am developing Proxy Society’s architectural PhD question: AI representatives acting for absent people through limited mandates that can be withdrawn. A proposed comparison places delegated service either beside a shared neighbourhood meeting space or in a separate collection recess. Residents would redraw the threshold and identify tasks for which they want to appear personally.

Could you refer me to a researcher with experience in co-production or community-space evaluation? I would like to discuss the protocol before proposing any workshop, participant recruitment or site visit.

Best regards,
Kris Haamer

Dear BookStop team, for the attention of Nicholas Paredes,

Your current BookStop page names Nicholas Paredes as the library-network contact and labels Intramuros under rehabilitation and BGC inactive (https://www.wtalabs.ph/the-book-stop-project). I would first like to clarify those published statuses.
